Lemma
1. Lemma 2.1\group ch02-maximum-principles Source: han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0029

Let $u\in C^2(\Omega )\cap C(\overline\Omega )$, with $Lu>0$ and $c\le 0$ in $\Omega $. A nonnegative maximum of $u$ on $\overline\Omega $ cannot occur in $\Omega $.
Proof

\sketch At an interior nonnegative maximizer $x_0$, one has $Du(x_0)=0$ and $D^2u(x_0)\le 0$. Positivity of $(a_{ij}(x_0))$ and $c(x_0)u(x_0)\le 0$ give $Lu(x_0)\le 0$, contradicting $Lu>0$.

□
